headline: Draw on your board, link your images
summary: Write and highlight on top of anything, and connect images with links that follow them around.

new.title: Brush and highlighter
new.description: Write, sketch, or highlight on top of images and notes without changing them. Boards with brush strokes need RefBoard 2.1.5 or later.

new.title: Links between images
new.description: Drag an arrow from one image to another to link them. The link stays attached when you move either one.

improved.title: Clearer arrows
improved.description: Arrows have a cleaner shape and an outline that keeps them visible on any image. Change their color, size, and heads from the selection bar.

fixed.title: Menus in Export images and Settings
fixed.description: The Format, Export order, and Naming menus open again, along with the menus in Settings.

fixed.title: Double-clicking annotations
fixed.description: Double-clicking an arrow, or tapping twice with the brush, no longer jumps the view.
